questions.question: What is a coordination compound?
options: A compound with a central metal ion bonded to ligands
questions.correct_answer: A compound with a central metal ion bonded to ligands
questions.explanation: Coordination compounds consist of a central metal ion surrounded by ligands (molecules or ions that donate electron pairs).

questions.question: What is the coordination number in [Fe(CN)6]⁴⁻?
questions.explanation: The coordination number is the number of ligand donor atoms attached to the metal. In [Fe(CN)6]⁴⁻, Fe is bonded to 6 CN⁻ ligands.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a coordination compound?
questions.explanation: [Fe(CN)6]⁴⁻ is a coordination compound with iron (Fe) as the central metal ion and cyanide (CN⁻) as ligands.

questions.question: What is a ligand?
options: An ion or molecule that donates electrons to a metal
questions.correct_answer: An ion or molecule that donates electrons to a metal
questions.explanation: Ligands are molecules or ions that donate electron pairs to the central metal ion, forming coordinate covalent bonds.

questions.question: What type of isomerism is shown by cis- and trans- isomers in coordination compounds?
questions.explanation: Cis-trans isomers in coordination compounds are geometric isomers. They differ in the spatial arrangement of ligands around the metal.

questions.question: What is the denticity of ethylenediamine (en)?
questions.explanation: Ethylenediamine (en) is a bidentate ligand because it has two donor atoms (both nitrogen atoms) that can bind to the metal.

questions.question: Which of the following is used in cancer treatment?
questions.explanation: Cisplatin is a coordination compound used in chemotherapy to treat various types of cancer.

questions.question: What is a chelate?
options: A coordination compound with a polydentate ligand forming rings
questions.correct_answer: A coordination compound with a polydentate ligand forming rings
questions.explanation: Chelates are coordination compounds where a polydentate ligand forms ring structures around the metal ion (chelation).
